{
  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "moral",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning the rehearsed wish in front of the whole assembly and spending her First Sacrifice on Lirael instead, blurring the wording so as not to name the wound aloud",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_beat": "Seren’s voice falters mid-invocation, the practiced words dissolving into a plea for Lirael’s unseen burden—her hands trembling as she clutches the ceremonial sash, the Dohkar’s sharp gaze locking onto her",
    "rising_beats": [
      "Lirael’s fingers tighten around the muffling band, her breath hitching as Seren’s voice drops to a whisper, the veil-canopy swaying like a warning",
      "Julian shifts at the edge of the gathering, his stillness the only thing that hasn’t moved since the rite began"
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Should she rip the band from her mouth and let the assembly hear the truth—or let Seren’s kindness twist the wish beyond repair?",
    "pc_career": "Sacrificiant",
    "opening_setting": "Veilwood ceremony clearing",
    "environment_elements": [
      "the deep-crimson carpet of braided mated-pair spiralgrass",
      "the pale mated-pair trees’ hanging leaf-curtains"
    ],
    "interlocutor_placement": "Seren, the youth making her First Sacrifice, her fingers tracing the ornate sash she clutches too tightly, her voice breaking just before the words she’s rehearsed for months",
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "beat 1 — she adjusts the muffling band across her mouth, the fabric catching on her front tooth, the one she’s always hated for being crooked, and wonders if anyone else notices",
    "scene_want": "wants Seren to name the wound plainly, even if it means the wish breaks—just to see if someone will finally look at her the way she’s been looking at Julian all morning",
    "scene_mission": "Stop Seren from twisting the wish before the Dohkar can halt it, without breaking protocol in front of the whole assembly",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "Seren is mid-sacrifice, abandoning the rehearsed words for Lirael’s sake, and the Dohkar is watching closely",
      "believes": "The wish is about to twist, and Lirael’s only recourse is her eyes and a muffled cry",
      "wondering": "Why does Julian refuse to meet her gaze?",
      "must_not_confuse": "Who is speaking the wish (Seren), who is supervising (Lirael), and why the Dohkar’s sharp reaction"
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "opening — stress_tic (the grandmother’s ring)",
    "li_body_callback": "beat 2 — focus_tell (the way his knuckles whiten when Seren’s voice drops)",
    "staged_characters": [
      { "name": "Lirael", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION" },
      { "name": "Julian", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "Seren", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "the presiding Dohkar", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" }
    ]
  },
  "scene_skeleton": {
    "character_plus": [
      {
        "character": "Seren",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-4",
        "expression_mode": "CONTRADICT",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "Seren’s fingers stumble over the sash, her voice softening as she blurs the words of the wish, her eyes flicking to Lirael’s covered mouth",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
        "behavior_person_ids": ["pc:lirael"],
        "revelation_bridge": "The way she avoids naming the wound plainly—even when it’s Lirael’s—reveals her belief that softening the truth is kinder than forcing someone to endure it directly.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "INWARD_TRANSLATION_OF_ANOTHER_PERSONS_COST",
        "pc_interpretation": "Seren believes she’s protecting Lirael by not speaking the wound aloud, but it’s just another way of keeping it buried."
      },
      {
        "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-8",
        "expression_mode": "CONTROL",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "The Dohkar’s gaze snaps to Seren’s hands, his posture stiffening as he waits for the misaligned words to land fully before speaking",
        "behavior_object_ids": [],
        "behavior_person_ids": ["named:seren"],
        "revelation_bridge": "His assumption that his judgment carries authority over the wish’s alignment, even when it’s being twisted by someone else’s mercy.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "EMOTIONAL_CONCLUSION_BEFORE_EVIDENCE",
        "pc_interpretation": "The Dohkar thinks his authority should override Seren’s hesitation, but he’s wrong about what the wish needs."
      }
    ],
    "environment_plus": {
      "target": "the deep-crimson carpet of braided mated-pair spiralgrass",
      "axis": "damage",
      "beat": "the carpet’s braids are frayed where Seren’s bare feet have dragged, the red threads snagged on her trembling hands as she kneels"
    },
    "pc_opening_fusion": {
      "character": "Lirael",
      "placement": "PC_FIRST_EMBODIED_BEAT",
      "character_angle": "Her body reacts before her mind does—she’s already translating Seren’s hesitation into her own wound before the words are even spoken.",
      "environment_target": "the pale mated-pair trees’ hanging leaf-curtains",
      "environment_axis": "absence",
      "beat": "Lirael’s fingers brush the veil-canopy, the cool leaves catching on her sash as she leans in, her breath shallow against the muffling band"
    }
  }
}
